title: Shopping category menu item without selected state

license.name: BSD-3-Clause
license.copyright: Copyright 2019 The Flutter team. All rights reserved.

component.description: A category entry in a shopping menu; the selected category is indicated by a painted triangle and a darker text color.

violations.description: The selected category is indicated only visually by the triangle and text color; the selected state is not exposed through semantics.

mutations.description: Removed the selected state from the Semantics of the category item, preserving role, enabled state, visuals and callback.

notes: Adaptado de _buildCategory de CategoryMenuPage (ADR-R011): ScopedModelDescendant e AppStateModel foram substituídos pelos parâmetros isSelected e onCategoryTap; Category foi substituído por categoryName; GalleryOptions.textScaleFactor e a distinção desktop/mobile foram fixados nos valores mobile (fonte 19, indicador 30); shrineBrown900 e shrinePink400 foram copiados de colors.dart; TriangleCategoryIndicator foi copiado de triangle_category_indicator.dart.
